text:
anya: Heads-up, canary p95 started drifting after the merge to release/v2.5.0. Deploy-bot shows a 45% increase in token latency for embeddings. Holding traffic now.
deploy-bot: AUTOSUPPRESS: Canary hold engaged by safety-latch. Reason: p95_latency > threshold. (auto-suppressed fallback)
sam: @anya thanks — do we want a manual pin to v2.4.9 or attempt fast rollback?
anya: I prefer pin to v2.4.9 for public endpoints, then a targeted rollback on embeddings route if we see errors. Low blast radius but we should be conservative.
michael: Agree with pin + targeted. Can ops run quick smoke on customer-facing flows first? If green we can avoid full rollback.
ops-runner: I'll run smoke now. Quick checks: login, search, embeddings-create, and streaming. ETA 90s.
sre-jen: Note: metrics show increased KV cache misses coincident with the merge — could be model kv-compat issue. If smoke shows regressed embeddings quality, roll back.
ops-runner: smoke results: login OK, search OK, embeddings-create latency elevated but successful, streaming unaffected. No errors returned.
sam: So no functional errors, but cost-latency hit. What's the acceptable p95 we can live with for the window?
anya: For hosted-api standard tier we need p95 <= 420ms. Current is 680ms. Not acceptable. Pin + canary traffic cut seems right.
kate: I'll update release notes and customer status draft: "Investigating elevated embeddings latency after v2.5.0; temporary pin to previous stable planned." Any specific wording for CSE?
michael: Mention that we expect temporary pin and rollback plan if smoke fails. Call out estimated window ~30min.
anya: ops-runner, please apply manual pin on routing for embeddings route to tag `v2.4.9` and keep canary suppressed. Use the pin tool with reason: "p95 latency spike, temporary pin"
ops-runner: Running:
```
pin-router --route embeddings --to-tag v2.4.9 --reason "p95 latency spike, temp pin"
```
ops-runner: Pin applied. Traffic shifted for embeddings route to v2.4.9 (95% immediate, 5% canary).
deploy-bot: NOTE: Auto-rollback suppressed by operator pin. To re-enable auto rollback, run `deploy-bot revert-suppression`.
sre-jen: Good catch. We'll keep suppression until we confirm model kv fix. Recommend running a small controlled rollback to v2.4.8 on a subset if latency persists.
michael: If latency still > 500ms after pin, escalate to rollback plan B: full rollback to v2.4.8 for embeddings nodes. Ops-runner, standby to execute `rollback --to-tag v2.4.8 --select embeddings`.
ops-runner: Standing by. If triggered I'll run the command and notify in this thread.
anya: Kate, CSE note updated. Sam, please prepare the public post in case we expand impact.
sam: On it. Draft ready for approval.
ops-runner: Follow-up smoke after pin: embeddings p95 dropped to 390ms. Streaming & search unchanged.
anya: Nice, thanks. Let's keep suppression for 1 hour and monitor. If no regression, we can unpin and reattempt merge with a KV compatibility patch.
sre-jen: I'll open a ticket to investigate KV codepath and add a regression test. Ticket: INF-1729.
kate: Customer note queued, will hold send until 15m stable. (:+1:)
michael: Marking as resolved for immediate incident. Reopen if metrics re-spike.
anya: Closing loop: manual pin applied, auto-rollback suppressed, smoke verified, follow-up ticket created. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
